name: Compendium mission types
summary: Fixer's Guidebook + Freelancer's Handbook fully enabled, so Salvage / Stealth / Street Fight jobs appear in World Phase step 3.
note: HIGHEST-RISK BLOCK. All four were LIVE in code and unreachable in campaign play until Aug 6 2026 (TacticalBattleUI.initialize_battle early-returned whenever selected_tier was stamped, which CampaignTurnController does on every campaign battle). That fix has never been confirmed on hardware. JobOfferComponent._generate_compendium_missions() injects the three job types into step 3 gated purely on these DLC flags, so enabling them is the whole setup — then accept one and check the mission-type panel actually builds in TacticalBattleUI.
